current_date: December 2024 ('Version: December 2024'; planning page says 'published December 2024')
current_evidence: The council's apply-for-planning-permission page links media/829 as the 'adopted local list of validation requirements (PDF) published December 2024' and says an updated list will be 'consulted on and published soon'. No newer version was found online.

issues.detail: Lighting Assessment and Ventilation/Extraction details are placed under Householder, but the source explicitly excludes householder applications from both.
issues.evidence: 'All applications, except householder, where it is proposed to incorporate external flood lighting'; 'Applications which will incorporate a ventilation/extraction system, with the exception of Householder applications'

issues.detail: 23 requirements are placed under Full planning with 'INFERRED: application type not named', and the Householder, Outline, Reserved matters, s73 and other rows say there are no local requirements. Most items in the source apply to 'All applications' meeting the trigger, for example Site Levels and Sections, Roof Plans, Tree Survey, Heritage Statement, Biodiversity Survey, Flood Risk Assessment and Amendment Statement (which is specifically for revisions and variation/removal of conditions), so they should also appear under householder and other types.

Local requirements in the December 2024 list that Grokbot did not capture: Amendment Statement (revisions to approved applications, variation or removal of conditions); Demolition Plans (recommended, so CIL is charged on net additional floorspace); Contaminated Land Investigation (majors on brownfield sites, EIA development, or known contamination); Noise Impact Assessment (new housing next to major noise sources such as roads, rail and industry); Retail or Leisure Impact Assessment (retail/leisure over 2,500 sqm, smaller schemes affecting small centres, or out-of-centre/edge-of-centre town centre uses not in line with the plan); Location Plan and Elevation Plans as local items with triggers.
issues.evidence: media/829 Advisory and Supporting Information sections, items 8, 9, 13, 18, 20

issues.detail: Several trigger excerpts are fragments that do not say when the item applies. Air Quality: 'provide an air quality assessment as part of their planning application.' (actual trigger: development within Air Quality Management Areas). Arboricultural/Tree Survey: 'British Standard BS5837.' (actual: trees within or adjacent to the site, including street trees). BNG: 'of mandatory Biodiversity Net Gain.'. CIL form: a sentence about becoming a charging authority. Environmental Statement: 'This information might form part of an Environmental Statement'. Highways: 'public highway, visibility splays, landscaping...'. Viability: '...paid for by the applicant.'. Street scene: '...may be required.' (actual: new dwellings or new buildings visible from the highway).
issues.evidence: Grokbot app_type_rows trigger_excerpt values vs media/829 'Requirement:' lines

issues.detail: The Structural Survey trigger misses the main local trigger. The source requires it for barn conversions and reuse of existing rural buildings, and where part of a heritage building is demolished because of its condition. Grokbot's excerpt mentions only substantial demolition, reconstruction or alteration. The SuDS row misses the 'all major development' trigger and its major thresholds.
issues.evidence: 'Applications involving barn conversions or re-use of existing rural buildings'; SuDS: 'All major development proposals'

issues.detail: The Full planning Ventilation/Extraction row is sourced from the superseded Local List 2022 PDF (Local+List+2022-Planning.pdf), not the current December 2024 list.

Most tab_items are process or boilerplate text, not requirements: file size limits (5MB/10MB), accepted file formats, GDPR advice, 'If valid, we aim to register and acknowledge within five working days', the 21-day invalid-application disposal and admin charge, 'View the adopted local list ... published December 2024', 'Page 1 of 15', and common invalidity reasons ('Not adding a scale bar...').
issues.evidence: Grokbot tab_items 'Submission rules' and 'Drawing / document standards' sections

issues.detail: 'Biodiversity Checklist / Questionnaire' and 'Ecological Survey / Assessment' are the same source item (Biodiversity Survey and Report and Protected Species Guidance) with identical excerpts. Ventilation/Extraction appears twice under different app types from different list versions. The drawing standards tab repeats 'Indentify/Identify the original paper size and scale'.
issues.evidence: Identical excerpt 'Page 9 of 15 Biodiversity Survey and Report and Protected Species Guidance – Requirement: All applications...'

issues.detail: The Design and Access Statement and Environmental Statement rows quote national validation boilerplate rather than a local requirement. The list's own Heritage Statement trigger ('All applications, affecting heritage assets or their settings') is recorded only under Listed building consent.
issues.evidence: D&A excerpt: '(see below) o Design and Access statement (where required) The correct application fee...'

summary: Grokbot's link is the current Brentwood list (December 2024; an update is being prepared). However, it puts the lighting and ventilation requirements under Householder even though the list excludes householder applications, misses about five local requirements (Amendment Statement, Demolition Plans, Contaminated Land, Noise, Retail Impact), and uses many fragmentary triggers and process text.
grok_review: Reviewed by Grok 5 Nov 2026; Claude responded to every disagreement the same day.
